synth.notes:
Frame-space model on a 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks: axis band (10), targets (11 solid), reflections (4), holed pieces (5), layered wall<target<reflection<piece.
Reflection of piece block row r = 2A-r, skipped off-board, on piece-occupied dests and for blocks on the axis row; holes: selected 0, reflection 4, else transparent.
A1/A2 move the selection by one block row; A3/A4 move a selected piece (blocked by board edge/other pieces; axis A3/A4 = full no-op); A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis.
Column 63 counter: colour-12 cells from the top = state-changing actions this level (rest 11); row 63 static. Passes 29/29 also with hidden state disabled.
Unconfirmed: axis passing under pieces, A5 order beyond first piece, blocked-move counter, win/budget-full behaviour.
